game.citadels.name: Citadels
game.citadels.desc: Draft a hidden character every round, tax the city and raise eight districts before anyone else in this classic game of medieval scheming.
game.citadels.rule.1: Draft a character in secret each round; the character decides your special action and turn order.
game.citadels.rule.2: Take gold, build districts and reach eight districts to trigger the final round. The most valuable city wins.
game.citadels.option.round_limit_hint: A match nobody can finish ends after this many rounds and is decided on points.
game.citadels.option.two_roles_hint: With two or three players everyone drafts two characters per round, as the printed rules suggest.
game.citadels.role.assassin_power: Name a character: it is struck down and will not act this round.
game.citadels.role.thief_power: Name a character: you take all of the gold it holds.
game.citadels.role.magician_power: Swap your whole hand with a player, or discard it and draw as many cards.
game.citadels.role.king_power: Take the crown and collect one gold for every noble district you built.
game.citadels.role.bishop_power: Collect one gold for every religious district; the Warlord cannot touch your city.
game.citadels.role.merchant_power: Collect one gold, plus one more for every trade district you built.
game.citadels.role.architect_power: Draw two district cards and build up to three districts this turn.
game.citadels.role.warlord_power: Pay one gold less than a district's cost to raze it from another city.
game.citadels.draft_prompt: Pick the character you want to play this round — it stays hidden until it is called.
game.citadels.killed_line: The {role} was struck down this round.
game.citadels.power_used: Your character power has been used this turn.
game.citadels.build_hint: Click an affordable district to build it.
game.citadels.log_start: {players} players take their seats and the city awaits.
game.citadels.log_round: Round {round} begins: {player} holds the crown and chooses first.
game.citadels.log_draft: {player} picks a character and passes the hand on.
game.citadels.log_killed: The Assassin struck: the {role} never acts this round.
game.citadels.log_architect: The Architect lets {player} draw {count} extra district cards.
game.citadels.log_complete: {player} completes a city of eight districts!
game.citadels.log_discard: {player} discards {count} cards and draws as many.
game.citadels.reason_city_complete: A player completed a city of eight districts; the highest score wins.
game.citadels.reason_round_limit: The round limit was reached; the highest score wins.
game.citadels.error.unknown_action: This action does not belong to Citadels.
game.citadels.error.illegal_action: That action is not available now.
game.citadels.error.role_unavailable: That character has already been taken.
game.citadels.error.bad_target: That is not a legal target.
